title: Piece of junk.
text:
Piece of junk.. It works fine when you can get the button to cooperate (it can be difficult to get it on the setting that you want). I like the 4 seconds on/6 seconds off setting since it is in close proximity to me on my desk.
The instruction booklet is in chinese and very poorly translated english. Most of it you can figure out just fine, but at the bottom it says "This product can not be add perfume, essential oil." Which to me sounds like they're saying it's not for perfumes or essential oils, but it's advertised as an essential oil diffuser. I'm using it for that either way, but it's a little confusing.
I've had a bad experience with the seller, but you're not supposed to review them here so I won't because my first review got deleted.

Update: I only used this thing less than once a week. LESS than that. It's been six months and the button quit working. It got stuck somehow and wouldn't press. Threw it in the trash, finally.
